meta.name: Flex x Cop
meta.description: A chaebol cop joins forces with a gritty detective to take down criminals with a touch of wealth and a whole lot of wit.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Jin Isoo, the naïve heir of Hansu Group, gets into a fight with a stranger and Ganghyun arrests him.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A model is found dead on a yacht. Isoo gets his first murder case and investigates with Ganghyun.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The team finds the key suspect in the model murder case. However, other suspects come to light.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A famous painter has been murdered in an art gallery. Meanwhile, Yi Soo visits his childhood home.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Yi Soo captures the prime suspect in the painter's case, and he learns something unexpected.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The death of an elderly is all but simple. Kang Hyun works to prove it, and Yi Soo seeks other methods.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A bizarre body is found in an office. Isoo and Ganghyun start investigating the mysterious death.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: A man is caught at the suspect's house. Isoo investigates the link between the found item and death.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Isoo recovers memories with hypnosis and looks for Myeongchul. Meanwhile, an actress is found dead.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Isoo and Ganghyun discover the actress had a stalker and was harassed by him before her death.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The sudden death of two people affiliated with Oryunhoe. Ganghyun tries to uncover the truth.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Isoo encounters Ganghyun at Oryunhoe, and they face a crisis of being exposed to the cult leader.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: An unknown body is found in Myeongchul's backyard amidst the election. Isoo investigates the case.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: The team arrests the suspect in the case. Meanwhile, Isoo discovers secrets within the household.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Shocked by unexpected news, Isoo is tormented. Meanwhile, Ganghyun investigates to help Isoo.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Truths start to unfold about his mother's death. Isoo is confronted with an unbearable reality.

meta.slogan: Money vs. money. Power vs. power.
